title: Wolf Alice, Four Tet, Wilco & Mogwai to Headline 2026 Green Man Festival
summary: Tickets for this summer’s Welsh weekender are already sold out.
contentText:
Wolf Alice , Four Tet , Wilco and Mogwai are set to top the bill at the 2026 edition of Green Man Festival.

The four-day event, scheduled for Aug. 14–17, will return to the scenic Bannau Brycheiniog National Park nestled in the Welsh countryside. As ever, the independent festival will spotlight a wide-reaching mix of U.K., Irish and international talent across multiple stages.

Mogwai will kick things off on the opening night, with U.S. indie icons Wilco following on the Friday evening and Four Tet heading up the lineup on Saturday, following his last headline slot at the festival in 2019. On the final evening, recent BRIT Award winners Wolf Alice will close out proceedings.

Elsewhere, there’ll be performances from the likes of Cat Power, Sparks, The Beta Band, Aldous Harding, Anna Calvi, Baxter Dury, Cate Le Bon, Dry Cleaning, Nation of Language and Wednesday.

There will also be appearances from Shame, Mannequin Pussy, The Beths, Fcukers, Daniel Avery, Smerz, Sorry, Panic Shack, Westside Cowboy, Maria Somerville and Tyler Ballgame, among others. The full announcement can be viewed below, while further names are set to be announced in the coming months.

Launched in 2003, Green Man Festival has previously played host to the likes of Big Thief, Laura Marling, St. Vincent, Father John Misty, Fontaines D.C., Kraftwerk and many others. The 2025 edition saw headline sets from Underworld, Kneecap, TV On The Radio and previous Billboard U.K. cover stars Wet Leg.

With a capacity of 25,000, the event extends far beyond music, presenting comedy, theater, literary talks and science workshops as part of its expansive annual program. Tickets for this year are now sold out, but resale tickets are available exclusively via  Tixel .
